headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 15, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins 7-0, with Zack Wheeler leading the way on the mound. Wheeler pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters while allowing 0 earned runs. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Dylan Crews hitting a crucial home run. The St. Louis Cardinals shut out the San Diego Padres 3-0, with Dustin May earning the win.

Injuries and availability are impacting several teams. Corey Seager has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, with the move retroactive to June 12, 2026. Grayson Rodriguez has been placed on the 15-day injured list with low back inflammation. Jorge Polanco and Christian Scott have also been placed on the injured list, with Polanco suffering a right wrist contusion and Scott dealing with a right hip impingement.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Kansas City Royals acquired right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash. The Seattle Mariners traded right-hander Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash. The Cleveland Guardians traded right fielder Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Mets Suffer 12-0 Shutout Loss to Reds**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets fell to the Cincinnati Reds 12-0, marking a tough outing for the team. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with 2 home runs and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Shut Out Padres 3-0**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a shutout victory over the San Diego Padres with a final score of 3-0. Dustin May earned the win for the Cardinals, pitching 9.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Seager Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, with the move retroactive to June 12, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.
